production.note: US model years. First: BMW NA's release is titled 'The New 2021 BMW M3 Sedan and M4 Coupe' ('Market launch set for March 2021'). Still on sale: on 2026-10-01 bmwusa.com's M4 technical page listed the M4 Coupe ('473 @ 6,250', '6-speed, manual', 'rear-wheel drive') alongside the M4 Competition and M4 Competition xDrive (bmwusa-m4-coupe-tech); the page's imagery is labelled MY27.

body.note: 'M4 Coupe'. bmwusa.com lists the non-Competition M4 only as a coupe (bmwusa-m4-coupe-tech); the M4 Competition models are separate variants.

aspiration.note: 'Two, mono-scroll turbochargers with electronically controlled wastegates'

fuel.note: Inferred from the release's description of the gasoline S58 inline-6.

drivetrain.note: 'the new BMW M3 and M4 core models are delivered with rear-wheel drive and a 6-speed manual transmission'; 'Drive type | -- | RWD | RWD | RWD | RWD'. M xDrive is offered only on Competition models.

transmission.note: 'Transmission type | -- | LS58 6-speed manual | M8HP76 8-speed auto' (the automatic is for the Competition columns); 'the new BMW M3 and M4 core models are delivered with rear-wheel drive and a 6-speed manual transmission'. bmwusa.com still lists the M4 Coupe with '6-speed, manual' only (bmwusa-m4-coupe-tech).

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power | hp | 473 @ 6,250 | 503 @ 6,250 | 473 @ 6,250 | 503 @ 6,250" (columns M3 Sedan, M3 Competition, M4 Coupe, M4 Competition). Also: "The new S58 powerplant delivers 473 hp at 6,250 rpm". bmwusa.com still rates the M4 Coupe "473 @ 6,250" (bmwusa-m4-coupe-tech).

weightLb.note: 2021 M4 Coupe with the 6-speed manual (its only transmission). Quote: "Curb weight | lbs. | 3,840 | 3,890 | 3,830 | 3,880" (columns M3 Sedan, M3 Competition, M4 Coupe, M4 Competition). bmwusa.com's current M4 Coupe page gives "3,829" (bmwusa-m4-coupe-tech).

sources.title: The New 2021 BMW M3 Sedan and M4 Coupe

discrepancies.reason: Model year: 3,830 lb is BMW NA's 2021 launch figure; 3,829 lb is the current (MY2026/27) bmwusa.com figure for the same manual coupe.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,830 lb because the reference model year is 2021.
